proposals.before: On yiwei, former Anzhou commissioner Liu Suining became Left Martial Guard general; Binzhou commissioner Jiao Jixun became Right Martial Guard general; and former Yongxing commissioner Zhao Zan became Left Valiant Cavalry general.
proposals.after: On yiwei, former Anzhou commissioner Liu Suining became Left Martial Guard general; Fuzhou (鄜州) commissioner Jiao Jixun became Right Martial Guard general; and former Yongxing commissioner Zhao Zan became Left Valiant Cavalry general.
proposals.reason: Chinese 鄜州節度使焦繼勛 was mistranslated as Binzhou; 鄜州 is Fuzhou, not 邠州 Binzhou.

proposals.before: Yougui had been acting commander at Yongxing; when Zhao Siyun's revolt broke out he lost the city, and only now was he punished for it.
proposals.after: Yougui had been acting commander at Yongxing; when Zhao Siyun made his sudden assault he lost the city, and only now was he punished for it.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic 'revolt broke out' invents a framing not in 奔沖; the Chinese describes Zhao Siyun's sudden rush/assault, not the outbreak of a revolt.

proposals.before: On renshen, Liu Ci moved from Huazhou to Xingzhou, Yang Xin from Anzhou to Binzhou, and Wang Lingwen from Beizhou to Anzhou, each with an enlarged fief.
proposals.after: On renshen, Liu Ci moved from Huazhou to Xingzhou, Yang Xin from Anzhou to Fuzhou (鄜州), and Wang Lingwen from Beizhou to Anzhou, each with an enlarged fief.
proposals.reason: Chinese 移鎮鄜州 was mistranslated as Binzhou; 鄜州 is Fuzhou, not 邠州 Binzhou.

proposals.before: On day renshen, Liu Ci of Huazhou was transferred to Xingzhou, Yang Xin of Anzhou to Binzhou, and Wang Lingwen of Beizhou to Anzhou; all received enlarged fiefs.
proposals.after: On day renshen, Liu Ci of Huazhou was transferred to Xingzhou, Yang Xin of Anzhou to Fuzhou (鄜州), and Wang Lingwen of Beizhou to Anzhou; all received enlarged fiefs.
proposals.reason: Literal also renders 鄜州 as Binzhou; correct place is Fuzhou (鄜州).

proposals.before: Binzhou acting commissioner Wang Rao became Huazhou commissioner in reward for attending court.
proposals.after: Fuzhou (鄜州) acting commissioner Wang Rao became Huazhou commissioner in reward for attending court.
proposals.reason: Chinese 鄜州留後 was mistranslated as Binzhou acting commissioner.

proposals.before: Wang Rao, acting commissioner of Binzhou, was made military commissioner of Huazhou because he had come to court.
proposals.after: Wang Rao, acting commissioner of Fuzhou (鄜州), was made military commissioner of Huazhou because he had come to court.
proposals.reason: Literal likewise misreads 鄜州 as Binzhou.

proposals.before: On bingwu the emperor's brother Liu Xun, Xingyuan commissioner, was named Kaifeng mayor and vice grand councilor but had not yet left the palace.
proposals.after: On bingwu the emperor's brother Liu Chengxun (承勛), Xingyuan commissioner, was named Kaifeng mayor and concurrent Zhongshu Ling but had not yet left the palace.
proposals.reason: Chinese personal name is 承勛 (Chengxun), not Liu Xun; phrasing 興元節度承使勛 is a corrupted 興元節度使承勛.

proposals.before: On day bingwu, the emperor's younger brother, Liu Xun, commissioner of Xingyuan and imperial envoy, was made mayor of Kaifeng and additionally Vice Grand Councilor, but had not yet left the inner quarters.
proposals.after: On day bingwu, the emperor's younger brother Chengxun (承勛), commissioner of Xingyuan, was made mayor of Kaifeng and additionally Zhongshu Ling, but had not yet left the inner quarters.
proposals.reason: Literal invents Liu Xun and 'imperial envoy'; source name is 承勛.

proposals.before: On xinwei an edict sent palace-guard foot commander Wang Yin to encamp at Chunzhou.
proposals.after: On xinwei an edict sent palace-guard foot commander Wang Yin to encamp at Chanzhou (澶州).
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou/Danzhou (modern Puyang area), not Chunzhou; same error pattern as elsewhere for 澶州.

proposals.before: Former Huazhou commissioner Bai Zaiyun was killed by mutineers; personnel vice minister Zhang Yun fell from a building and died.
proposals.after: Former Huazhou (滑州) commissioner Bai Zaiyun was killed by mutineers; personnel vice minister Zhang Yun fell from a building and died.
proposals.reason: Chinese 前滑州 is Huazhou/Huazhou (滑州); idiomatic 'Former Huazhou' is acceptable but clarifying 滑州 avoids confusion with 華州.

proposals.before: Xuzhou inspector Ma Duo reported commissioner Liu Xin had committed suicide.
proposals.after: Xuzhou (許州) inspector Ma Duo reported commissioner Liu Xin had committed suicide.
proposals.reason: Chinese 許州 is Xuzhou/Xuchang (許州), not Jiangsu Xuzhou (徐州); packet English collapses the distinction.
